caption: The drawing depicts a carved ornamental architectural detail in the form of a corbel or bracket. The object is rendered in shades of light to medium brown, suggesting a wood or stone material, and exhibits intricate patterns with swirling acanthus leaves, volutes, and convex forms. The composition is heavily focused on the object itself, which is shown in a three-quarters view with the background left plain and unadorned in an off-white or cream color. The decoration features a prominent circular or disk-like central element surrounded by scrolling, leaf-like shapes, and the lower section tapers to a pointed end. The carving is detailed with fine lines indicating the texture and direction of the decorative elements.
title: Ship's Billethead
